name: Continuous build
body:
How to use the AppImage packages:
1. Download the Hugin_Panorama_Creator-*.AppImage
2. Make it executable.
In a terminal, go into the download folder and type
```
chmod u+x Hugin_Panorama_Creator-*.AppImage
```
3. run the package as any other Linux executable
